# Instructions: Code Connect Guidelines

## Authoritative Source

This file exists only as the Copilot-discoverable entrypoint (via `applyTo`). If it conflicts with the knowledge instructions, follow the knowledge instructions and report the conflict. Do not expand this file into a second full copy — keep durable rule changes in `knowledge/core/instructions/code-connect/guidelines.instructions.md`.
